result.stdout:
signweave — generate typed clients for ASP.NET REST + SignalR APIs.

Usage:
    signweave generate --project <csproj> [--target <name>] [--out <dir>] [--config <path>]
                       [--warnings-as-errors] [--warnings-baseline <file> [--update-warnings-baseline]]

Commands:
    generate      Extract IR from an ASP.NET project and emit clients.

Options:
    --project <csproj>    Path to the backend csproj (required).
    --target <name>       A consumer from --config, or an adapter (typescript|dotnet|vue|react).
                          Default: every consumer in --config, else typescript.
    --out <dir>           Output directory (default: the consumer's 'output', else ./generated).
                          Takes one target: with several consumers, combine it with --target.
    --config <path>       Optional signweave.yaml: consumers, filters, serialization overrides.
    --warnings-as-errors  Fail (exit 1, nothing written) on any warning.
    --warnings-baseline <file>
                          Accept the warnings listed in <file> ('CODE subject' per line);
                          any other warning fails the run. See docs/diagnostics.md.
    --update-warnings-baseline
                          Write the current warnings into the baseline file, then generate.
    -h, --help            Show this help and exit.
